arrivals.rule: arrived_at = row index in seconds; fixed spacing, not Poisson or retimed gaps

frontier_replay.request_id_binding: frontier_request_id is the row ordinal; the harness records the actual runtime ID mapping

measurement.e2e: per-request client issue to last output token; not workload makespan
measurement.origin: first formal request issue after warmup drain; independent clock origin per repetition
measurement.population: formal rows only, separately for each clean repetition; never warmup IDs
measurement.statistic: mean for TTFT, TPOT and per-request E2E; p50/p95 diagnostic only
measurement.thpt: 917504 formal prompt-plus-output tokens / the formal measurement window duration in seconds
measurement.ttft: per-request client issue to first output token; internal prefill completion is diagnostic only
measurement.window_end: last formal client output token; not last arrival or the later idle/KV-release check

native_request_contract: One /v1/completions request per row at its phase-relative arrived_at; construct exactly num_prefill_tokens deterministic valid prompt token IDs from the stable template request_id and the model vocabulary in the native harness; repeat-qualified transport IDs must not change prompt content. Do not tokenize text, download weights, truncate, or add BOS/EOS tokens. Use max_tokens = min_tokens = num_decode_tokens and ignore_eos; runtime evidence must confirm actual prompt and output counts.

repetitions.request_id_binding: the harness qualifies every formal and warmup template ID with repeat=1,2,3 before dispatch
repetitions.sequence: warmup -> both roles idle and request-owned KV released -> formal -> both roles idle and request-owned KV released; repeat three times

reproducibility.rule: fixed integers, ordered rows, UTF-8, LF, sorted JSON keys; no timestamps, absolute paths, or external inputs

selection.rule: all 128 deterministic formal rows, in row order, in every repetition

source.rule: k = 1024 tokens; 6k prompt and 1k output per request
source.sharedgpt: deferred; historical frozen SharedGPT artifacts are unchanged

warmup.coverage_limit: sixteen aggregate warmup completions do not prove all-lane CUDA Graph replay; runtime evidence must establish coverage on every required lane/rank
warmup.end: last warmup output plus observed PREFILL/DECODE idle and all request-owned KV released before the first formal request
warmup.origin: separate warmup origin before each repetition; not the formal origin
